## What changes?

Describe the problem, the behavior change and the scope. Link an issue if applicable.

## How was it verified?

List exact commands, environment and results. Mark tests not run and explain why. Separate synthetic, renderer, native, hardware and real-account evidence.

## Risk and compatibility

Describe permissions, outgoing data, dependencies, state migrations, optional runtimes and recovery/rollback impacts. For UI changes, attach redacted before/after screenshots.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves unrelated work.
- [ ] Relevant regression coverage and documentation are updated.
- [ ] No credentials, private state, generated environments or restricted assets are included.
- [ ] Upstream source/assets retain their provenance and notices.
- [ ] Skips, mocks, unavailable integrations and remaining limits are explicit.
- [ ] I reviewed the contribution guide and current licensing status.
